tldr: Protests across France escalated with nearly 1,800 arrests and widespread damage in Paris, prompting President Macron to address the nation.
Russia and Ukraine traded strikes on each other’s power infrastructure, resulting in two deaths and 17 injuries.
US stock markets saw declines, with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite closing lower amidst a tech sell-off and concerns over rising borrowing costs.

market.why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite closed lower, with markets facing a high-stakes showdown where strong earnings are colliding with rising borrowing costs. A silent market rotation inside the S&P 500 warned of potential weakness, and AI stocks experienced a plunge.

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield saw a slight increase as investors reacted to rising borrowing costs and fears of potential rate hikes. Hedge fund activities were also noted as a potential factor that could increase the risk of a global bond market shock.

vix.why: The VIX increased, reflecting heightened market volatility and investor uncertainty. This rise was consistent with the significant declines observed in the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite, as AI stocks plunged and broader market weakness was anticipated.

watchlist.read: Near the bottom of its 1-month range and oversold on RSI. Big session: down 12.7% in a day.
Within 4% of its 1-month low. Big session: down 7.6% in a day.

mortgage.why: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate remained stable this week, which aligns with the minimal change observed in the 10-year Treasury yield over recent days, as mortgage rates typically track the direction of bond yields.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: This document contains final regulations regarding the deduction for certain taxpayers for an amount up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.
policy_upcoming.effect: You can deduct up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_calendar.label: ACA marketplace open enrollment opens — expected early November
policy_calendar.note: healthcare.gov has opened enrollment on November 1 each year, and currently publishes December 15 as the deadline for coverage starting January 1. The window is set by federal rule and has been changed by rulemaking before.

policy_calendar.label: IRS 401(k) and IRA contribution limits for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: The annual cost-of-living adjustment notice, historically released within a week or two of the bracket figures. It sets how much can go into a 401(k) and an IRA next year.

policy_calendar.label: IRS tax brackets and the married-filing-jointly standard deduction for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: Published as an annual inflation-adjustment revenue procedure; recent releases landed between mid-October and mid-November. These are the bracket thresholds and the standard deduction the next return is filed against.

tech.summary: Meta has updated its terms to remove language that previously suggested it could scrape content from websites, including news sites, to train its AI models, following public backlash.
Microsoft has withdrawn from a large AI datacentre project in Essex, UK, citing concerns over power supply, posing a setback for the development heralded by ministers.
New AI devices, including always-listening wearables from major tech companies, are pushing legal boundaries regarding privacy and raising concerns about potential covert recordings.

world.summary: France has seen widespread protests, with approximately 1,800 arrests and significant damage to streets in Paris as anger over school conditions combines with frustration over high living costs.

Russia and Ukraine have continued to trade strikes on each other’s power infrastructure, resulting in two fatalities and at least 17 injuries after a previously declared "energy ceasefire" broke down.
Attacks by Israeli settlers on Palestinians and foreign officials in the West Bank have escalated, coinciding with the annual olive harvest season, prompting condemnation from France and Belgium.
Pope Leo XIV has stated he will gradually resume his duties after undergoing cancer surgery, thanking faithful followers for their prayers during his hospitalization.

us.summary: Authorities identified the 16-year-old suspect in a deadly school shooting at an elementary school in Bend, Oregon, as a former student of the institution.
$86 million in federal funds intended for teen pregnancy prevention programs nationwide has been redirected to a single large contractor with connections to the Trump administration.
In states with paid family leave programs, men are now filing the majority of claims, surpassing women in some areas as they utilize the benefit to bond with new children.

science.summary: The American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists has updated its guidelines for the treatment of menopause symptoms for the first time since 2014.
A pioneering same-day test using metagenomics is offering a new method for detecting infections in intensive care patients, with reports indicating it has saved lives.

weekly_recap: This week, global markets experienced significant downturns, influenced by concerns over AI fatigue impacting chip stocks, reports of a global stock rout by a Chinese chipmaker, and rising US inflation. Geopolitically, the "energy ceasefire" between Ukraine and Russia broke down, leading to renewed strikes on power infrastructure. Tensions also escalated in the West Bank with settler attacks. Amidst these events, Pope Leo underwent successful lung cancer surgery, and a school shooting occurred in Bend, Oregon.
